'''Rebecca Honig''' (born '''Rebecca Handler''') is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Honig began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} starting with [[S07|the seventh season]]. She continued voicing characters up until [[4Kids Entertainment|4Kids]] gave up the dubbing rights to [[The Pokémon Company International|Pokémon USA]] and [[TAJ Productions]].
